description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. The right menu's gesture section gained a "Simultaneous View Control" toggle: touch-pad dragging and key-based pointer follow are two independent look paths, and with the toggle off (the default) whichever starts dragging first owns look control while the other's deltas are ignored until it is released; turning it on lets both control the view at once, and the setting persists in the in-game menu settings.
2. Fixed opening folders and links doing nothing on 26.3: links opened by the game through SDL_OpenURL used to be handed straight to the system and are now forwarded to the launcher, which shows the file browser for file: paths and delegates the rest to the system.
3. Fixed "hold" interactions such as Create's numeric settings screen being cut short: switching cursor mode no longer pre-emptively resends mouse-button releases, since a mode switch is not a lost event source - a held button is released when its own source lifts, and only the hover-coordinate snapshot is invalidated.
4. Fixed mouse buttons synthesized by the touch pad's long-press gesture getting stuck when the cursor mode changed mid-hold: the up/cancel path now releases the synthesized left/right buttons and retracts an untriggered long-press regardless of mode, instead of only in the capture branch.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.右菜单手势分类新增"同时控制视角"开关：触控板拖动与按键指针跟随是两条独立的转视角路径，默认关闭时先开始拖动的一方独占视角控制权，另一方的增量在占用期间被忽略、抬起后释放；开启后两者可同时转视角，开关状态持久化到游戏菜单设置
2.修复 26.3 下游戏打开文件夹与链接失效：游戏经 SDL_OpenURL 打开的链接此前被直接交给系统，现转交启动器处理，file: 路径弹文件浏览器、其余交给系统
3.修复机械动力数值设置界面等"按住"交互被瞬间打断：光标模式切换不再抢先补发鼠标键释放，模式切换不等于来源丢失，按住中的键等来源自身抬起时再释放，仅作废悬停坐标快照避免整段位移
4.修复按住期间切换光标模式导致长按手势合成的鼠标键卡住：抬起与取消事件统一释放合成的左/右键并撤回未触发的长按，不再只在捕获分支处理
